Todd C. Miller's 1998 BSD string implementation
==============================================

`strlcpy.c` is pristine FreeBSD 7.0 source, retaining the complete copyright,
three-clause BSD license and disclaimer in its header. Its OpenBSD revision is
1.4 (1999-05-01); the implementation copyright is 1998.

Source repository: https://github.com/freebsd/freebsd-src

Release tag: `release/7.0.0`

Pinned commit: `ba209d619d07461cc752dcdd596ab0d9b50e847a`

Upstream path: `lib/libc/string/strlcpy.c`

The FreeBSD identification macro is supplied by build glue on other platforms.
No function or license text is modified here. Candidate selection and matching
against each firmware remain separate from this source provenance.
